$description: DuplicateAction (platform/patterns/DuplicateAction), library wave 10, lane B: its pattern tokens. The rename dialog’s content: the gaps between the name field, the source line and the options, and the source line’s icon and text; the trigger, the dialog and the toast keep their own tokens.

duplicate-action-gap.$description: DuplicateAction: gap between the name field and the source line (space-stack-sm).

duplicate-action-options-gap.$description: DuplicateAction: gap between the field, the source line and the options (with options) (space-stack-md).

duplicate-action-source-gap.$description: DuplicateAction: gap between the source icon and its words (space-inline-xs).

duplicate-action-source-line-height.$description: DuplicateAction: source line height (and its icon box) (size-20px).
